Title: Small World Wuxi search
Description: Returns the 100 nearest neighbours of a query molecule from the WuXi collection, drawing on SmallWorld, an index spanning more than 230 billion molecular substructures. Sayle and colleagues built it around exact maximum common edge subgraph size rather than fingerprint overlap, precomputing the index so that neighbours of a query can be retrieved from databases of millions of compounds within seconds. Queries are posted to an external server, so results depend on that service and on the version of the library indexed.
Interpretation: List of the 100 nearest neighbours to the query molecule in the WuXi library.
